valuation.method: Forward Tangible Book Value per share (TBV/share) x justified P/TBV at the 12-month horizon (Nov 2027). NYSE: DB trades as Global Registered Shares (1:1 with Frankfurt ordinary shares). Q3 2026 TBV/share of EUR 31.87 and forward EUR TBV/share estimates are converted to USD at the 2026-11-13 EUR/USD rate of 1.1023.

bear.driver: Macro slowdown, higher credit provisions, and RoTE slipping to ~9.0%

base.driver: Steady execution toward >13% 2028 RoTE target (11.5%-12.0% RoTE) with 60% total payout

bull.driver: Accelerated RoTE expansion to ~13.0%+ with strong IB/corporate banking and buybacks

valuation.implied_by_close: At Q3 2026 TBV/share of $35.13 (EUR 31.87), the $36.62 close implies 1.04x trailing P/TBV (or 0.96x base forward TBV/share of $38.03); the $43.00 consensus USD target implies 1.13x base forward TBV/share.
valuation.sensitivity: A 0.10x change in P/TBV on base forward TBV/share ($38.03) moves the base target by $3.80 (10.4 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Post-tax RoTE (10.6% in Q3 2026; 11.5% in 9M 2026) and CET1 ratio (14.0% in Q3 2026 vs. 13.5%-14.0% target range)
valuation.next_disclosure: FY 2026 preliminary/annual results (expected late January / early February 2027)

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 results on Oct 28, 2026 (10.6% post-tax RoTE, EUR 31.87 TBV/share, 14.0% CET1), Goldman Sachs, UBS, and Morgan Stanley raised their EUR targets (converted at 1.1023 EUR/USD) on stronger operating leverage and capital return visibility, while JPMorgan maintained Overweight and Citigroup stayed at Hold. Most named targets cluster in the $41.89-$45.19 range, closely aligned with our $41.83 base case (+14.2%), though Goldman Sachs sits higher at $52.63 (implying ~1.38x base forward TBV/share). Note: EUR targets were converted at the 2026-11-13 FX rate of 1.1023, and horizon_months is left null where the broker's 12-month horizon was not directly verified.
